content.description: Electrical schematic showing solenoid resistor connected from ignition switch to six injectors, with connections to ECU No. 10 and ECU No. 20. The diagram shows two resistor elements in series within the solenoid resistor box, with parallel connections branching to six fuel injectors.
Illustration of solenoid resistor component showing a finned heat sink with two wire connectors labeled No. 10 and No. 20, and a ground terminal labeled +B

content.text: Using an ohmmeter, measure the resistance between +B and other terminals.
